name: casafari-location-lookup
description: Casafari Location Lookup: turn a place name into the Casafari location id that Comparables and Area Insights take. Free.

interface.longDescription: Find any place by name, from a country to a neighbourhood, and get the Casafari location id with its type and its parents (municipality, province, region). Free to call. Use it with Comparables and Area Insights by Casafari to ask about a precise area. Coverage: Andorra, Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, Luxembourg, Monaco, Poland, Portugal, San Marino, Spain and Switzerland. Built by Casafari, the AI agent-native real estate data intelligence platform.
defaultPrompt: Find the Casafari location id for Chamberí, Madrid
Which places called Santa Cruz are in Casafari's locations?
